name: Jae Hoon Seo
title: Assistant Professor in Marine Structures
photoAlt: Professor Jae Hoon Seo, Director of the SMI Lab at Inha University
bio: Professor Jae Hoon Seo directs the Marine Structural Mechanics and Integrity Lab at Inha University. He works on the structural integrity of ships and offshore wind structures, spanning ductile fracture and impact mechanics, ultimate strength, and, in the lab's current programme, virtual sensing and digital twin methods for floating offshore wind turbine moorings and dynamic power cables. Before March 2025 he held faculty positions at Cranfield University and Newcastle University in Singapore, and a principal researcher position at Inha University.
